summary: Defines BUNDLE, an extension to the Session Description Protocol that lets several media streams, such as audio and video, share a single transport connection instead of using one each. It builds on the SDP offer/answer mechanism and adds related RTP Control Protocol items. Sharing a connection reduces the number of ports and NAT or firewall pinholes needed. It obsoletes RFC 8843.

eli5.summary: Instead of sending each toy in its own truck, you load them all into one truck. Fewer trucks need to cross the road.

questions: how to send audio and video over one port
